pages.description: Free generator for software companies: ready-to-paste Organization, WebSite, SoftwareApplication (one Offer per plan) and FAQ structured data.
Free check of whether AI crawlers can fetch and read your product docs, and whether they can tell what each page covers.
Free audit of the pages that decide a software deal: homepage, pricing, product, integrations, comparison, customers, docs and security.
Free check for the trust and security pages a software buyer asks for, and the ones AI assistants answer 'is it SOC 2 compliant?' from.
Free check that your pricing page shows the right currency in each market, and what AI crawlers will read when they fetch it.
Free check of whether your plan prices are in the HTML that Googlebot and the ChatGPT, Claude and Perplexity crawlers actually read.
Free one-URL report: can search engines index the page, are the on-page basics right, and can AI assistants reach, read and trust it.
Free llms.txt generator: a curated map of your site written for AI assistants, the way robots.txt and sitemaps are written for crawlers.
Free check of whether your robots.txt blocks ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity and other AI crawlers from reading your site.
Free JSON-LD generator for your brand: the structured data Google uses for rich results and AI answer engines use to get your facts right.
Free redirect map validator for site migrations: does each old URL redirect, and to the right new page rather than just any page that returns 200?
Free redirect tracer: paste a URL to see every hop, or check that a domain's four http, https, www and non-www versions land in one place.
Free website migration checklist: every stage of a domain move, replatform or redesign in order, from the pre-migration audit to post-launch monitoring.
Free phase-by-phase checklist for migrating from Optimizely CMS to Webflow, including content-type-to-collection mapping and redirects.
Free structured data audit: what a page carries, what is missing for its type, and where the markup claims something the page does not show.
Free sitemap analysis: finds your sitemap, checks its structure and spot-checks the URLs it lists for dead links.
Free sitemap.xml generator: crawls your site and builds a sitemap for sites that have none or whose current one is stale or broken.
Free image audit for a page: missing alt text, layout-shift risk, lazy-loading, legacy formats and broken or oversized images.
Free E-E-A-T check: author, freshness, substance, citations, HTTPS and the other individually checkable signals Google's rater guidelines point at.
Free hreflang audit: finds the mistakes that break international targeting, such as missing self-reference, invalid codes and relative URLs.
Free user-agent comparison: fetches a page as two different crawlers and shows what differs in status, title, canonical, noindex, H1 and structured data.
Free locale check: fetches a page with different Accept-Language headers and flags automatic redirects or content swaps by language.
Free PageSpeed comparison: your Lighthouse score and Core Web Vitals next to up to two competitors', on mobile and desktop.
Free IndexNow pinger: tell Bing and other IndexNow search engines that specific URLs changed, instead of waiting for the next crawl.
Free Google review link generator: a direct link to the 'leave a review' box on your Google Business Profile.
